description: This file defines the DictionaryDatabase class for an Android app, managing the creation, population, and querying of a searchable dictionary database using SQLite and FTS3 virtual table for full-text search.

classes.name: DictionaryDatabase
classes.description: A class that manages a searchable dictionary database, including creation, loading initial data from resources, and providing query methods for retrieving words and definitions.

classes.name: DictionaryOpenHelper
classes.description: An inner class extending SQLiteOpenHelper, responsible for creating and upgrading the database, and loading initial word entries from a resource file.

methods.name: buildColumnMap
methods.description: Constructs a HashMap for column aliasing used in database queries, mapping standard column identifiers to database columns or aliases.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a Cursor positioned at the specific word identified by rowId.

methods.name: getWordMatches
methods.description: Retrieves a Cursor over all words matching the specified search query.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query with specified selection, selectionArgs, and columns, returning a Cursor with queried data.

methods.name: loadDictionary
methods.description: Starts a background thread to load initial dictionary words from a raw resource file.

methods.name: loadWords
methods.description: Reads words and definitions from an InputStream and inserts them into the database.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Inserts a new word with its definition into the database; returns the new rowId or -1 on failure.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the virtual table for FTS and initiates loading of dictionary words.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping the existing table and recreating it.
